//: Balance, not infrastructure. Every value here defaults to what this server was measured or recovered at, so deleting this file changes nothing. Only what the archive does NOT declare belongs here -- the difficulty and party rates, each dungeon's weight and the level thresholds are content and are read from Script.pvf.

Experience.//Curve: What a monster of a level is worth: PerLevel x (level + LevelHeadStart), under a percentage of 100 + GrowthPercentPerLevel x (level - GrowthBeginsAtLevel). Recovered from a hundred-entry table; ninety-nine entries reproduce exactly.
Experience.//WorthDivisor: What that worth is divided by before anything else. The one number no evidence in hand can check: what was captured constrains this times the curve, not either alone.
Experience.//RankRates: By MonsterRank: ordinary, champion, super champion, boss. The first two are evidenced by capture; the other two are the reference server's word.
Experience.//LevelGapBands: monsterLevel - characterLevel, first band containing it wins. Must run unbroken from -2147483648 to 2147483647 or the server refuses to start: a difference in no band has no rate. Only the 1-to-3 band is evidenced.
Experience.//ChannelReward: The channel's own reward is NOT here. It is declared in Resources/Channel/channel_info.etc: the [server] section binds each channel to a dungeon group and states the percentage it adds, and the [dungeon] sections list each group's dungeons. A channel pays only for its own dungeons. Change it there, not here.
Experience.//PremiumRates: What a premium term adds, keyed by the type the account row carries. Empty by default: the archive declares no rate for any of its fifty-two premium types, so any number here is an operator's choice. Example: "1": 0.20
Experience.//LabelProbe: A measurement, not a play setting. Pays a distinct amount into every bonus slot so the client names each line itself; raises only what is reported, never what is stored.
